assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 算力设施涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护、供电与市政容量等控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意与接口预留。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and utility control conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 算力规模、电力负荷、PUE、投资等数据仅有公开政策与报道口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造算力容量、用电量或投资数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified compute capacity, power, or investment figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 算力调度、能耗优化与碳效追踪均以匿名聚合为边界，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Anonymized aggregation only; no individual-identifying tracking; human review for key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI生成的科普展示与传播内容须经人工审核后发布，遵守版权与署名要求，不夸大算力能力或活动效果、不把设想写成已确定安排。
assumptions.statement_en: AI-generated display and communication copy requires human review; no overstated claims.

assumptions.statement_zh: 绿电直供与余热回收涉及供能政策与电网条件，本方案仅作概念接口建议，不构成供电或能源容量承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Green-power supply and heat reuse are concept-level interface suggestions only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 无障碍与可达性水平以人工审核和现场实测为准，机器验证（含本包四门禁）不能替代无障碍人工审核；具体参数以专项设计与实测为准。
assumptions.statement_en: Accessibility is certified by human review and on-site measurement; machine validation cannot substitute for accessibility human review.
